identity_evidence: Wikisource header 'Executive Order 377-B', signed December 7, 1905; authorizes Isthmian Canal Commission quarterly session of January 1, 1906 in Washington
basis: A one-time authorization for the Isthmian Canal Commission to hold one quarterly session in Washington; it concerned Canal construction administration and was used up by that session, and the Zone and canal operation ended long after.
end_or_bound: no later than 1906-01-31 (one-time session of 1906-01-01); in any event no later than 1999-12-31
operative_quote: The quarterly session of the Isthmian Canal Commission for the 1st of January next may be held at the office of the Commission in Washington, D. C.
notes: Text is numbered 377-B; claimed number is 377 (a 377-A also exists per the page header). Date and subject agree with the claim.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 1989', signed July 9, 1914, Board of Admeasurement oaths and attendance of witnesses
basis: Gives the Canal Zone Board of Admeasurement power to swear witnesses and obtain court process to compel attendance, enforced through the Zone District Court and Penal Code; applies only within the Zone.
operative_quote: The Board of Admeasurement of the Canal Zone, and the respective members thereof, are hereby authorized to administer oaths to witnesses appearing before the Board

identity_evidence: Signed Woodrow Wilson, The White House, November 7, 1913; 'establish the following order for the Canal Zone' on carrying arms
basis: Zone police regulation: penalties for carrying arms and hunting permits issued through Zone officials and the Zone treasury; applies only in the Zone.
operative_quote: Anyone who carries on or about his person any firearm, dirk, dagger or other knife manufactured or sold for the purpose of offence or defence
notes: Text has no number or heading; identity rests on date, signer, Canal Zone subject and arms topic matching the claimed title.

identity_evidence: Signed Woodrow Wilson, The White House, August 14, 1914; 'establish the following order in the Canal Zone' on security for costs in civil suits
basis: Court procedure for the Zone district and magistrates' courts on security for costs; applies only to Zone courts.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts and police)
operative_quote: The plantiff in any civil suit, or special proceeding, may be ruled to give security for the costs upon motion of the defendant
notes: Text has no number or heading; identity rests on date, signer and subject.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 1239', signed August 20, 1910, Conveyance of Real Estate by Married Women in the Canal Zone
basis: Zone civil-law rule on how married women's real estate instruments are executed and acknowledged before Zone judges, clerks and notaries; its validating and saving clauses protect only instruments already made, which are accrued effects.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts and police)
operative_quote: Any deed or other instrument in writing relative to or affecting real estate the separate property of a married woman, or any mortgage or other lien on such property, shall be sufficient
notes: Article 4 also lets officers in the States or abroad take acknowledgments, but only for instruments under Zone law, so judged incidental. Articles 2 and 5 validate or save earlier instruments (accrued effects).

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 774', signed March 31, 1908, Jury Trial Amendments amending EO 750
basis: Amends the Zone jury-trial order for criminal prosecutions by changing a title; it matters only through the Zone court system.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts and police)
operative_quote: Executive Order No. 750, dated February 6, 1908, providing for a system of jury trials in criminal prosecutions in the Canal Zone, wherein the penalty of death or imprisonment for life may be inflicted, is hereby modified
notes: The amendment is a one-phrase wording change to EO 750; its operation depended on EO 750 continuing, which ended with Zone courts.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 474', signed June 30, 1906, Fixing Compensation for Members of the Isthmian Canal Commission
outliers_found: fixes salaries and allowances of named individuals (Shonts, Stevens, Magoon, Endicott, Hains, Harrod): person-specific pay orders, spent on issue; belongs in an individual-order lot
basis: The order sets pay, housing and expenses for specific named commissioners, so it is a set of person-specific orders rather than a rule governing the Zone; it fails the outlier test.
operative_quote: That Theodore P. Shonts, Chairman of the Commission, receive a salary of $30,000 per annum.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 2142', signed March 1, 1915, opium and coca leaves in the Canal Zone under the Act of December 17, 1914
basis: Applies a federal drug-tax act inside the Zone only, giving duties to the Auditor and Collector of the Panama Canal and requiring Zone registration and a Zone tax; it reaches nothing outside the Zone.
operative_quote: That on and after the first day of March, 1915, no person shall produce, import, manufacture, compound, deal in, dispense, sell, distribute, or give away in the Canal Zone opium or coca leaves
notes: Implements a statute by direction of Congress, but only for the Zone.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 2455', signed September 15, 1916, transferring administration of the Act of September 7, 1916 to the Governor of The Panama Canal
outliers_found: administers a general federal employees' compensation act and also covers Panama Railroad Company employees (Panama Railroad corporate matter)
creates and administers compensation payments to injured employees and their survivors, a continuing individual right that later federal compensation law may have preserved
removes minimum limits for alien employees (conditions of service rest on a general U.S. statute)
basis: The order reaches Panama Railroad Company employees and administers a general federal compensation statute whose benefits are individual rights that may continue, so the Zone-only reason for NO cannot be applied to it on its own text.
operative_quote: so far as employees of The Panama Canal and of the Panama Railroad Company are concerned, is hereby transferred to the Governor of The Panama Canal.
notes: Claimed date is only '1916'; text is dated 15 Sept., 1916, which is consistent.

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 1749', signed March 19, 1913, Providing for the Protection of Birds and their Nests in the Canal Zone
basis: Bans hunting or taking birds and eggs in the Zone except as regulations permit, with penalties and rulemaking power in the Commission or Governor; applies only in the Zone.
operative_quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to hunt, trap, capture, wilfully disturb or kill any bird of any kind whatever

identity_evidence: Wikisource 'Executive Order 1158', signed January 26, 1910, Authorizing Canal Commission to Construct Sanitary Improvements and to Charge Proportion of Cost to Owners of Adjacent Property
basis: Lets the Isthmian Canal Commission build sanitary works in the Zone and assess up to half the cost on adjacent Zone property owners; applies only in the Zone.
operative_quote: The Isthmian Canal Commission may, from the necessities of sanitation, cause such improvements to be made in the Canal Zone
notes: Liens from assessments already made are accrued effects.
